description: Betaflight CLI terminal for M5Stack Cardputer Zero

store.summary: Betaflight CLI, backups, and restores on Cardputer Zero.
store.description: A native Betaflight field terminal for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero. Connect a flight controller over USB or UART to run CLI commands, keep command history, inspect the keyboard map, and create or restore Configurator-shaped backups. Risky motor and erase commands require confirmation. GNDHOG ZERO runs locally without a network connection or background service.
